summary: During the review period, the factual accuracy of the account's reporting was high. Source attribution was inconsistent: primary and official sources were frequently linked, but a substantial proportion of claims were published without attribution.

scoreBreakdown.label: Factual accuracy
scoreBreakdown.text: The large majority of assessed claims were verified, with isolated instances of overstatement and of early, unconfirmed information being reported as fact.

scoreBreakdown.label: Source attribution
scoreBreakdown.text: Primary documents, official notices and on-the-record statements were regularly cited, but attribution was inconsistent and a significant share of claims carried none.

scoreBreakdown.label: Media handling
scoreBreakdown.text: Credit was typically preserved through platform sharing or retained watermarks; stock imagery was used for illustration.
